text:
Maria (CSM): quick sync on Elmwood private/VPC onboarding — go-live target in 2 weeks. Main open items: VPC routing/NAT, IAM role for redwood ingestion, KMS key policy + rotation, audit-log delivery & retention. Can folks surface blockers and ETA? Also flagging renewal risk if the basic infra isn't green by next Fri.

Arjun (Infra): looked at their route tables this morning — missing route for Elmwood app subnet (10.0.8.0/24) to our NAT/peer. I can add a temporary route but we need the peer update from their side. I ran quick probe from our bastion: 
```
# from redwood-bastion
curl -sS -D- https://10.0.8.12:8443/health || true
traceroute -n 10.0.8.12
```
response showed packets dropped at their border.

Kevin (DevOps): added a temporary route (rtb-0abcde -> 10.0.8.0/24 -> vpc-peering-elm) so management plane can reach the app. Not ideal long-term. Who owns the long-term change on Elmwood side?

Maria (CSM): Elmwood infra lead said they'll make the route change later today (they're pinged). Kevin — can you confirm the temporary route config and post the route id?

Kevin (DevOps): route-id rtbassoc-0f12345. I pushed it 1887654387. :thumbsup:

Sophie (SecOps): KMS notes: Elmwood asked for cross-account key so Redwood can decrypt logs when needed. We need an explicit key policy allowing our ingestion role and restricting usage to audit log S3 bucket. Draft policy snippet below — please validate with Elmwood before apply: 
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {
      "Sid":"AllowRedwoodIngest",
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-ingest"},
      "Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource":"*",
      "Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:ViaService":"s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
Also: require key rotation every 365 days and no key deletion without a 7-day waiting period. Audit log retention: our recommendation = 3 years default, extendable to 7 for regulated customers.

Maria (CSM): Sophie — can you post the minimal policy we can send to Elmwood infra so they can ok it? I'll include this in the enablement doc.

Sophie (SecOps): yes — I'll trim and provide a clean copy. For immediate unblock, permit redwood-ingest role + their account root for admin.

audit-collector-bot: audit-collector: delivery OK — last batch to s3://elmwood-redwood-audit at 1887654400 (size 12MB). Link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/elmwood-redwood-audit/2026-03-21/part-0001.json

Arjun (Infra): after Kevin's temp route I re-ran the probe, health returned 200 for the /health endpoint from our side. Please have Elmwood verify from their app side that callbacks to our webhook (10.0.8.200:9000) succeed — ask their SRE to run: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://webhooks.redwood.internal/elmwood/callback -d '{"test":"ping"}'
```

Kevin (DevOps): KMS plan: rotate key alias alias/elmwood-redwood-kms tomorrow 10:00 PT, I will stage and notify. Need Sophie signoff on policy and Maria to confirm Elmwood approval. I'll prepare the IAM role trust policy update too.

Maria (CSM): noted — I'm scheduling an enablement + handoff session for Wed 09:30 PT, invite sent to Elmwood infra + SRE. I'll attach the short checklist (network, IAM, KMS, logs, monitoring). If we don't close these by next Fri, renewal health moves to "medium" risk in our tracker.

Sophie (SecOps): I'll draft the SOC2 evidence checklist and the KMS policy email to Elmwood. ETA EOD today.

Kevin (DevOps): I'll update the S3 bucket policy to restrict PutObject to their delivery IAM role only and enable encryption-in-transit. Logging will remain enabled. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Maria (CSM): capture feedback: Elmwood mentioned they'd like a short runbook for triaging failed deliveries and a playbook for key rotation. I'll add that to the enablement deck. Also asked for a 30-min follow-up post-cutover for ops Q&A.

Arjun (Infra): once Elmwood confirms route and we finalize key policy, I'm happy to hand off to SRE for monitoring rules (CloudWatch + alert thresholds).

Maria (CSM): next steps recap: 1) Sophie share cleaned KMS policy (today) 2) Elmwood to apply route (today) 3) Kevin rotate key & update bucket policy (tomorrow) 4) Enablement session Wed 09:30 PT. I'll update renewal status after we see everything green. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

Kevin (DevOps): ack — I'll post the rotation runbook in the thread when done.

Sophie (SecOps): ack.

Maria (CSM): marking action owners in tracker now and adding note about customer feedback (runbook + post-cutover Q&A). Closing this thread — will reopen if blockers remain.
